subject: Partner integration follow-up — technical deep dive & calendar pairing
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rubin <sam.rubin@cloudharbor.com>, Alia Gomez <alia.gomez@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner integration follow-up — technical deep dive & calendar pairing

Hi Sam / Alia,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — really appreciate the context on CloudHarbor's marketplace roadmap and the connector requirements. Quick recap from our side:

- Value alignment: CloudHarbor’s customers want a low-friction marketplace listing that preserves tenant isolation; Redwood’s Dedicated/Private options map tightly to that ask.
- Must-haves: SSO + SCIM for onboarding, per-tenant logging, and support for the connector payloads with < 250ms p99 tokenization on short sequences.
- Opportunity: Marketplace listing + co-marketing after a short proof-of-concept and a combined tech deep dive.

Next step proposal: partner-led technical deep dive where your solutions architect walks through the connector spec and we map integration tasks. We suggest a 60–90 minute slot to cover: architecture walkthrough, manifest requirements for the marketplace, and a short Q&A.

Availability windows we can start with (PST):
- Tue 12 Mar: 10:00–12:00
- Wed 13 Mar: 13:00–15:00
- Thu 14 Mar: 09:00–11:00

Attached is our partner intake form (redwood-partner-intake-form.pdf) — if you can share the connector overview ahead of the deep dive that will help our platform engineer prep.

Camila and Vivek from our side will be on the call for technical intake and marketplace ops respectively. If you want to invite Jorge (solutions architect) please do.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-partner-intake-form.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: Sam Rubin <sam.rubin@cloudharbor.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alia Gomez <alia.gomez@cloudharbor.com>, Jorge Morales <jorge.morales@cloudharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Mar 2029 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner integration follow-up — technical deep dive & calendar pairing

Hi Vanessa — great to meet you this morning, thanks for the clear recap.

We’re aligned on the agenda and would love to run the deep dive from our side — Jorge will lead the connector walkthrough and surface the manifest + security expectations. We’ve attached a short connector overview that includes the current API surface and auth flows.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 12 Mar: 10:30–11:30 (preferred)
- Wed 13 Mar: 14:00–15:30 (backup)

We’ll invite Jorge (solutions architect) and Alia (partnerships) on the invite.

Attachment: cloudharbor-connector-overview.pdf

We also noted the SCIM/SSO ask — Jorge will have a couple of questions about your expected identity flows so having Camila on the call is perfect.

Thanks,
Sam Rubin
Head of Partnerships | CloudHarbor
sam.rubin@cloudharbor.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rubin <sam.rubin@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Mar 2029 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner integration follow-up — technical deep dive & calendar pairing

Thanks Sam — Tue 12 Mar 10:30–11:30 PST works for our team. I’ve penciled it in tentatively and will accept once we receive the calendar invite.

Quick agenda suggestion (60 min):
1) 5m intros & success criteria (Vanessa / Alia)
2) 25m connector architecture + data flow (Jorge)
3) 15m security & auth (Camila / Jorge)
4) 10m marketplace manifest & ops checklist (Vivek)
5) 5m next steps / mutual action plan

Mutual action plan (draft):
- CloudHarbor to share full connector spec (Jorge) — due by 3/9
- Redwood to share marketplace listing template + intake response — due by 3/12
- Both teams agree on POC success criteria and schedule a 2-week validation window post-integration

Camila: can you confirm you have bandwidth for the 3/12 slot and whether you want a pre-read from Jorge? Vivek: I’ll sync with Marketplace Ops about listing metadata — will share requirements in a follow-up.

Note: Procurement on our side will surface any contract/marketplace terms after the tech scope is locked; I’ll loop in the legal contact once we have a confirmed timeframe.

Looking forward — I’ll accept the invite once you send it through.

—
Vanessa
